snippet.title: LUCKROT - Official Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Roguelike shooter set in a dystopian, livestreamed gameshow. Obliterate waves of deformed freaks, earn donations from your sadistic audience and gamble your earnings for upgrades. Your life is a Performance. Your Death is Content.

Game on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3823650/LUCKROT/?curator_clanid=4777282
